deployments_detail.use: Videojet is piloting/deploying machine learning to optimize production scheduling and improve inventory forecasting and planning in operations [not disclosed]

Esko Comply, an AI-led artwork/label compliance module for WebCenter that scans packaging for missing allergens, incorrect barcodes and regulatory/brand violations, and performs automated image measurements without operator input [Esko (Veralto operating company)]

X-Rite Print Clone / eXact 2: a cloud-native, AI-powered color-matching solution whose algorithms calculate target color profiles to reproduce color from previously printed packaging on digital presses, reducing make-ready time and waste [X-Rite and Esko (Veralto operating companies)]

Pantone AI Palette Generator in Pantone Connect: a generative AI model trained in-house on Pantone's color library and trend research that creates custom color palettes from conversational prompts [Pantone (Veralto operating company)]

Hach Claros RTC (Real Time Control) modules, e.g. RTC-COAG, use machine learning to adjust coagulant dosing in real time to optimize chemical costs and maintain compliant finished water in water/wastewater treatment plants [Hach (Veralto operating company)]

Esko S2 multi-tenant cloud-native packaging platform that leverages AI across Esko products, partner integrations and APIs; expanded AI-enabled Packaging Cloud unveiled at Esko World 2026 [Esko (Veralto operating company)]

Esko + GlobalVision integration embedding AI-powered automated proofreading/inspection (Verify) into Esko WebCenter and Automation Engine to detect errors in text, graphics, braille, spelling, barcodes and color [Esko / GlobalVision (Veralto)]
Videojet ML print-quality monitoring + AI translation tools; Hach analyzer remote diagnostics; GreyMatter agentic AI (security ops)
Videojet deployed Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT Enterprise broadly across the operating company to improve employee productivity [Microsoft (Copilot), OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise)]
Videojet is working with a startup to design an AI-first ERP system that automates order intake [unnamed startup partner]
Videojet implemented AI-powered translation tools to create marketing content at scale across global markets [not disclosed]
